<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by ~/.claude/hooks/gen-invoke-skills.py — do not edit by hand; edit hooks/autonomous-skill-router.config.json / hooks/model-policy.json and re-run (`--check` verifies). -->

Sync vendored third-party skills with their pinned upstreams (`hooks/skills-sources.json`).

1. `python3 ~/.claude/scripts/vendor_skill.py --all --check` — report drift per skill (exit 1 = drift).
2. Only after the user confirms: `python3 ~/.claude/scripts/vendor_skill.py --all`.
3. `python3 ~/.claude/scripts/build_provenance.py --check` — report the R10 result.

Never run step 2 without an explicit yes — it touches the network and git.
